ayahs.tj: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ ١
ayahs.en: By the night when it covers

ayahs.tj: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ ٢
ayahs.en: And [by] the day when it appears

ayahs.tj: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ ٣
ayahs.en: And [by] He who created the male and female,

ayahs.tj: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ ٤
ayahs.en: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.

ayahs.tj: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ ٥
ayahs.en: As for he who gives and fears Allah

ayahs.tj: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ٦
ayahs.en: And believes in the best [reward],

ayahs.tj: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ ٧
ayahs.en: We will ease him toward ease.

ayahs.tj: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ ٨
ayahs.en: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

ayahs.tj: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ٩
ayahs.en: And denies the best [reward],

ayahs.tj: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ ١٠
ayahs.en: We will ease him toward difficulty.

ayahs.ar: وَما يُغنى عَنهُ مالُهُ إِذا تَرَدّىٰ
ayahs.tj: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ ١١
ayahs.en: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?

ayahs.tj: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ ١٢
ayahs.en: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.

ayahs.tj: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْأَخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ ١٣
ayahs.en: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

ayahs.tj: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ ١٤
ayahs.en: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.

ayahs.tj: لَا يَصْلَـٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى ١٥
ayahs.en: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.

ayahs.tj: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ ١٦
ayahs.en: Who had denied and turned away.

ayahs.tj: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى ١٧
ayahs.en: But the righteous one will avoid it -

ayahs.tj: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ ١٨
ayahs.en: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

ayahs.ar: وَما لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُ مِن نِعمَةٍ تُجزىٰ
ayahs.tj: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ ١٩
ayahs.en: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded

ayahs.tj: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ٢٠
ayahs.en: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.

ayahs.tj: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ ٢١
ayahs.en: And he is going to be satisfied.
